name: 海女小屋 鳥羽 はまなみ (Amagoya Toba Hamanami)

claims.text: Fried items such as the ebi-fry and large shrimp-fry sets are breaded (wheat panko) and deep-fried; no dedicated gluten-free fryer is indicated, so shared-oil cross-contamination should be assumed.

The signature tekone-zushi is made with bonito marinated in soy sauce, and sashimi/grilled dishes are served with soy sauce; standard Japanese soy sauce contains wheat and there is no gluten-free soy sauce mentioned.

The menu is entirely seafood-based (shellfish, fish, shrimp) and the tekone-zushi uses bonito; broths and dashi almost certainly use fish stock, so there is no realistic plant-based or bonito-free option.
